subject: ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro — Zephyr Bio opportunity
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@amazon.com>, Sara Torres <sara.torres@zephyrbio.com>
Cc: Megan Liu <megan.liu@zephyrbio.com>
Date: 2028-12-05T10:12:00Z
Subject: ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro — Zephyr Bio opportunity

Hi Alex & Sara,

Thanks for taking this initial signal — excited about Zephyr Bio's interest in listing and co-selling. Per our intake, Zephyr is an ideal fit for the ACE path given the regulated workload and expected ARR profile. Can we kick off ACE registration so AWS can validate eligibility and assign a PDM/PSM pairing?

Quick asks to get going:
- Alex, can you start the ACE intake and share the intake link & expected timeline?
- Sara, can you confirm Zephyr's preferred PDM/PSM contacts (or permission for AWS to assign)? Also flag any procurement/SOC2 constraints up front.
- Proposed times for a 30-min triage call (PST): 2028-12-06 16:00 or 2028-12-07 09:00 — let me know what works.

Attached: Zephyr_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (high level; still editable).

Goal for the triage: ACE registration intake, PDM/PSM intros, and a short runbook of next steps (enrollment, listing timeline, do-not-sell guardrails).

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0192
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@amazon.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sara Torres <sara.torres@zephyrbio.com>
Cc: Megan Liu <megan.liu@zephyrbio.com>
Date: 2028-12-05T16:30:00Z
Subject: Re: ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro — Zephyr Bio opportunity

Hi Jordan & Sara,

Thanks — I will start the ACE registration today. Short note on process: I’ll open the intake, route it to the ACE intake queue and loop in the regional Partner Development Manager (PDM) + Partner Solutions Manager (PSM). Typical turnaround to get a PDM/PSM assigned is 3-7 business days unless there are large compliance items.

Sara — two quick requests so I can include the right stakeholders:
- One-paragraph technical summary of how Zephyr plans to deploy (on-prem vs cloud, data residency).
- Any compliance artifacts you can share (SOC2 scope, encryption/KMS notes).

I’m also suggesting a 30-min call on 2028-12-07 09:00 UTC / 2028-12-07 01:00 PST (which lines up with one of Jordan’s options). If that’s not workable, propose two alternatives.

Link to ACE intake: https://partnercentral.aws/ace/intake (I’ll paste the intake ticket here once created).

— Alex
Alex Mercer
AWS ACE | Partner Programs
alex.mercer@amazon.com
From: Sara Torres <sara.torres@zephyrbio.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@amazon.com>
Cc: Megan Liu <megan.liu@zephyrbio.com>
Date: 2028-12-06T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro — Zephyr Bio opportunity

Hi Jordan & Alex,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Zephyr is keen to pursue ACE — we see value in the co-sell route for our genomics analytics runtime. A few clarifications:

- Deployment: customer-managed VPC in us-west-2 (we will be running on dedicated instances for PHI workloads).
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II in place; I attached the SOW draft earlier — I can share a redacted SOC2 report if needed.
- Procurement: our procurement lead prefers an initial statement of work + marketplace listing pricing to route internally.

I’m available for the call on 2028-12-07 09:00 UTC. If that works for Alex, please send an invite.

Thanks,
Sara

--
Sara Torres
Head of Product | Zephyr Bio
sara.torres@zephyrbio.com
Phone: +1 617 555 0123

Subject: Internal: ACE ops runway for Zephyr Bio (please review)

Kimberly / Karthik — looping you both in to drive the PDM/PSM intro and ACE intake respectively. Next steps I’m tracking:

1) Karthik: I asked Alex to open the ACE intake but we should populate the Redwood-specific sections in parallel (value props, target vertical, listing pricing guidance). Can you prepare a 1-page intake note and the ace_registration_form.pdf (I’ve attached the Zephyr SOW in the thread)?

2) Kimberly: can you lead the customer-facing PDM/PSM intro and own the first 30-min working session? Specifically, please be ready to:
   - Walk through our listing checklist (billing path, minimal listing artifacts).
   - Call out any model/feature guardrails for co-sell (data isolation, SLA expectations).
   - Confirm whether Redwood should handle the initial listing draft or hand it off to Zephyr for approval.

3) Compliance: Sara mentioned SOC2 Type II — please confirm what artifacts we need to include in the ACE intake to speed assignment.

I’ll coordinate a calendar invite for 2028-12-07 09:00 UTC if Alex confirms the intake ticket.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Thanks Jordan — I can take the PDM/PSM lead. Confirming availability for the 2028-12-07 09:00 UTC timeslot (I will join). Action items I’ll own before the working session:

- Draft the listing checklist and initial marketplace copy (I’ll share a one-pager by EOD 2028-12-09).
- Validate SOC2 scope — Karthik, please upload the redacted SOC2 and any encryption/KMS notes to the ACE intake ticket once Alex creates it.
- I’ll attach ace_registration_form.pdf with the minimal required fields filled; Jordan, please review prior to me posting it to the intake.

If Zephyr procurement needs an early SOW figure for approvals, I suggest we draft a 3-month pilot pricing option to accelerate internal sign-off (we can iterate on capex/term).

See quoted thread below.

—Kimberly
